intro: Twilight Lord Kelris is an orc warlock and high-ranking leader within the Twilight's Hammer cult operating deep inside Blackfathom Deeps. From his perch in the Moonshrine Sanctum, he leads dark rituals in worship of the primordial hydra Aku'mai, aiming to usher in a reign of cosmic chaos.

p: Twilight Lord Kelris directs the cultists of the Twilight's Hammer who seized the sunken ruins of Blackfathom Deeps. For years, Kelris slipped through the grasp of watchful eyes in Darnassus, evading the Argent Dawn and earning a grim reputation: whenever ancient malice stirred across Kalimdor, Kelris was suspected of orchestrating it. Rather than serving warlords or clans, this orc has pledged himself entirely to the Old Gods, seeking to unmake mortal civilization and return Azeroth to a state of absolute, primordial chaos.

Within the Moonshrine Sanctum, Kelris oversees the cult's worship of Aku'mai, a vicious three-headed hydra and servant of an Old God. Allied with the naga, the Twilight's Hammer occupies the drowned temple, and Kelris presides over the cult's rites, sacrificing innocents to Aku'mai for power.
